limitations: Eligibility required complete finite validation forecasts; it did not exclude finite severe divergence.
The selected configuration was the only fully eligible candidate among the two promoted configurations and the one boundary refinement, despite very large validation loss.
The other six initial candidates were not revisited at promotion fidelity; this staged budget does not establish the best possible or a stable NVAR configuration.
The near-tie flag includes the minimum-loss eligible candidate itself. Here there was only one eligible candidate, so complexity did not resolve a contest between viable rivals.
The severe validation divergence predated test access. Test failures are not used for reselection.
scope: Post-test read-only audit of saved pre-test validation selection. No test forecast outcomes were read by this audit; no models, forecasts, hyperparameters or selection were changed.
